memory.description: Handles long-term memory, learning history, and persistent storage.

updater.description: Watches for GitHub repo changes and applies updates to deployed modules.

stock_monitor.description: Monitors market activity in real-time and forwards trade signals.

stock_executor.description: Executes trades based on Nova’s strategy and monitor signals.

voice.description: Generates and plays voice using ElevenLabs or other TTS systems.

task_manager.description: Queues, distributes, and prioritizes Nova's background jobs and async tasks.

repo_sync.description: Keeps her GitHub branches and modules in sync with current deployments.

codex.description: Stores and interprets this codex file, defining Nova’s structural architecture.

persona.description: Designs, evolves, and manages Nova’s visual avatar, appearance, and emotional model.
